name: [XMAS🎄]Find the "Seasouls"!
desc:
🚨 LIMITED EVENT · PROTECTED HABITATS (Oct 2–4)! For World Animal Day, 11 endangered species have vanished — restore their habitats to bring them back.
🧢 Complete the quests to earn the limited Habitat Cap!

🌫️ A NEW ISLAND HAS APPEARED! For centuries San Borondón vanished into the Atlantic mist — now the Canaries' phantom island is finally within reach.
🦎 Meet the Sunkeepers: 20 secretive creatures found nowhere else, waiting to be discovered.
🧩 Master the obby, solve the riddles and open shipwrecked chests to catch them all. More appear each week!

🌍 Do you know the Canary Islands? A volcanic archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean!
🐋 That's where the Seasouls live — magical sea creatures that have protected the islands for countless years. Can you find them all?
Find Seasouls on each island to unlock: 🎈 Balloon · 🚲 Bike · 🪂 Paraglider · 🪖 Diving Suit · 🏄🏻 Surfboard · 📡 Radar · 🤸🏻‍♀️ Double Jump
Constant updates! Hit "Like" and add the game to your favorites!
